'''Nick Gibbons''' won the [[1997 Endor Regionals (Great Falls)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Heading into the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Decipher published this player statement.

"I'm originally from the San Francisco area, however, most of my life I've lived in Montana."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/gibbons.html Nick Gibbons], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427193712/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/gibbons.html Internet Archive]</ref>
"I'm currently enrolled at Montana State University at Bozeman, studying Accounting."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I'm an accomplished, award-winning pianist."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"Music and San Francisco sports teams are my first important hobbies (watching the 49ers win)."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"Obviously, the Star Wars trilogy is at the top of my movie list: I also enjoyed The Devil's Advocate,."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"The Usual Suspects, and the recent version of Sabrina, with Harrison Ford."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"Hopefully I can do well in the Worlds and give the small community of Bozeman some Star Wars CCG respect."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"The players here are very good and any one of us could have won the Regional."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"In fact, Tyler Franks, who qualified for the World Finals by winning the Edmonton Open, is from Bozeman."<ref name="dec97bio" />
